01. About

Who I Am?

I'm Abdul Wahid, a 5th Semester Computer Science student specializing in Artificial Intelligence at COMSATS University Islamabad, Attock Campus. Currently in my second year with a CGPA of 3.46/4.00, I'm deeply passionate about building intelligent systems that solve real-world challenges.

My primary focus is Machine Learning and Python development, where I've been implementing algorithms from scratch — from linear regression to multi-layer perceptrons. Alongside AI, I actively study Data Structures & Algorithms in Java to strengthen my problem-solving foundations.

I use modern AI tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to supercharge my development workflow, and I believe the future belongs to developers who can harness both traditional engineering and AI capabilities.

Beyond code, I'm driven by curiosity, discipline, and a goal to contribute to technology that matters — whether that's in AI research, software engineering, or building developer tools.
